location_description: Tierra Viva is located in the heart of Benahavís, the jewel of Costa Del Sol, and just 15 min away from Marbella. Tierra Viva is precisely nestled in the hills of Los Jaralillos, it is only minutes away from the shores of the Mediterranean and in close proximity to 12 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banús.

faqs.question: What is Tierra Viva?
faqs.answer: Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea.

faqs.question: What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva?
faqs.answer: Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living.

faqs.question: What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva?
faqs.answer: Tierra Viva offers a limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm. The collection is available in different villa configurations, including select units with an in-villa car lift. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and full specification details.

faqs.question: When will Tierra Viva be completed?
faqs.answer: Tierra Viva is under development with completion scheduled for June 2028. Construction is actively underway, with progress updates available on the DarGlobal website. Contact the sales team for current payment plan terms and unit availability.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Tierra Viva located?
faqs.answer: Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. The location gives direct access to 12 nearby golf clubs, Andalusian villages, and the shores of the Mediterranean, while remaining in one of the most prestigious residential areas on the Costa Del Sol.

faqs.question: What amenities does Tierra Viva offer?
faqs.answer: Tierra Viva is a gated community with 24/7 premium security, an exclusive residents' clubhouse, sauna, steam room, and private pool areas. Select Painite villas include an in-villa car lift. The community is designed around the concept of seclusion and belonging rather than shared hotel-style facilities.

faqs.question: Can I obtain a Spain Golden Visa by purchasing at Tierra Viva?
faqs.answer: Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. Given villa sizes and values at Tierra Viva, buyers should confirm current programme thresholds and eligibility with a qualified legal adviser, as Spain's Golden Visa rules have been subject to legislative review. DarGlobal can assist with introductions to legal professionals.

faqs.question: Why invest in Costa Del Sol real estate?
faqs.answer: Spain is consistently ranked as offering among the highest real estate ROI in Europe, with low Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, open regulations for foreign investors, and a robust tourism sector that supports rental returns. Benahavís specifically is one of the wealthiest municipalities in Spain and benefits from year-round Mediterranean climate and high-speed train connections to the wider coast.

faqs.question: What makes a Lamborghini-branded villa different from other luxury villas in Spain?
faqs.answer: Branded residences at this tier consistently command significant price premiums over comparable unbranded stock. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite.

faqs.question: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.answer: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

faqs.question: Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?

faqs.question: What unit types and sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

faqs.question: What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
faqs.answer: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

faqs.question: What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
faqs.answer: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

faqs.question: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
faqs.answer: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

faqs.question: Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.answer: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

faqs.question: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
faqs.answer: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. faqs.question: What did Mouawad design at Neptune?
faqs.answer: Mouawad provided the full interior design across each Neptune villa, applying the brand's heritage in precision and luxury material quality to every room from the entry foyer and living spaces through to the master suite, bathrooms, and kitchen. The collaboration translates Mouawad's jewellery-house sensibility into an architectural and residential context.

faqs.question: What villa sizes are available at Neptune?
faqs.answer: Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

faqs.question: When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?

faqs.question: Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?

faqs.answer: The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

faqs.answer: Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.
